# Recorded animal paw sources

Selected: **dog_running on wood floor 2.wav**, by **15GPanskaBokstefflova_Nicola**.
https://freesound.org/people/15GPanskaBokstefflova_Nicola/sounds/461524/
CC0 1.0: https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/

Compared and retained: **004 - Dog Running Past Mic on Linoleum, R-L.wav**,
by **Trashcan_Studios**.
https://freesound.org/people/Trashcan_Studios/sounds/580215/
CC BY 4.0: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
This unmodified comparator is distributed here with attribution; it is not mixed
into the player's footfalls. No endorsement by the original creators is implied.

The retained files are unaltered public high-quality **MP3 previews**, not the
login-only original WAV downloads. `sources.json` pins their exact hashes,
download URLs, original titles, license URLs and verification date.
`SourceArt/Audio/fetch_beast_footfalls.py` can restore the pinned sources.
`SourceArt/Audio/render_chase_voices.py` records all trims, rate/filter/layer edits
and output hashes. Its real dog paw layers replace shoe/metal sounds only in
the corridor wraith; the title's existing approach contacts remain independent.
